summary.text: Matt Bradford is a Democratic state representative from Montgomery County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 70 since his first election in 2008 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He leads the House Democratic Caucus as House Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Bradford earned both his undergraduate and law degrees from Villanova University and lives in Worcester Township with his wife and four children, according to his official biography.
Ballotpedia lists his earlier work as municipal administrator for Norristown Borough, solicitor for Montgomery County and a litigation associate at Drinker Biddle.
From 2019 to 2023 Bradford was the Democratic chairman of the House Appropriations Committee, and in 2023 his colleagues elected him to lead the House Democratic Caucus when it won the majority.
He chairs the House Rules Committee.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the general election for the district.
